program: Forskningsavdrag (Skatteverket: avdrag från arbetsgivaravgifter och allmän löneavgift för personer som arbetar med forskning eller utveckling, lag 2023:747); 2027 changes only proposed in lagrådsremisser of 11 June and 13 August 2026
stopper_list: Work must meet the narrow legal R&D definition: systematic, qualified, commercial purpose; research = new knowledge; development = research results a decisive prerequisite for a new or substantially improved product; ordinary ongoing product development excluded (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html; https://www4.skatteverket.se/rattsligvagledning/1334.html)

At least 50 % of the person's actual working time in the calendar month on R&D (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)
At least 15 hours of actual working time in the calendar month (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)

Vacation, sick leave and parental leave are not working time; an absence month counts only after the deduction was made under the main rule in each of the four preceding months, never if the person did other tasks (https://www4.skatteverket.se/rattsligvagledning/1334.html)

Only direct R&D work: no deduction for staff in ledning och styrning, support, service, maintenance, quality assurance, marketing, administration or running operations, which excludes the CEO at about 20 % R&D (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html; https://www4.skatteverket.se/rattsligvagledning/1334.html)

Commercial purpose: no deduction inside an R&D project run under public auspices and paid with public funds (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)

Age: no deduction for anyone aged 67 or older at the start of the year; deduction capped by the 10.21 % ålderspensionsavgift floor for ages 18-22 (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)

The employer must itself be able to prove every criterion per reporting period and per employee (bemannings-PM, planning documents, time reports, project descriptions, financing, research reports); Skatteverket may ask for them (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)

A confidentiality agreement with a client can block the evidence and put the deduction at risk; documents may be delimited and anonymised (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)

No advance application: base in ruta 470 and deduction in ruta 475 of the AGI for every month an employee qualifies (https://www.skatteverket.se/foretag/arbetsgivare/arbetsgivaravgifterochskatteavdrag/forskningsavdrag.4.8dcbbe4142d38302d7cb4.html)
Base is paid remuneration that carries Swedish employer contributions; no deduction from egenavgifter, no salary means no deduction (https://www4.skatteverket.se/rattsligvagledning/1334.html)
